I think about how we make room, try things, learn from reality, and notice what
matters.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    space["Make space"] --> practice["Move and practice"]
    practice --> feedback["Let reality answer"]
    feedback --> clarity["See a clearer next move"]
    clarity --> practice
    feedback -. "may leave" .-> remains["What may remain<br/>skill · judgment · support"]
```

This is a place for notes on work, family, health, tools, money, and the
practices that connect them. [Read the longer note](en/blog/2026-07-30-iteration-clarifies-what-matters.qmd).
